payload.text: **`intent st hydrate <ID>` RE-LISTS A CLOSED THREAD, AND `st done` OFFERS IT AS THE REMEDY FOR ITS OWN UNLISTING** (dc found and stopped on it, vc verified, 2026-09-17). Closing a thread removes its `STEELTHREAD:<ID>` line from `intent/.intentfiles` entirely, so nothing reconciles its tree afterwards and a disk edit to one of its attachments reads as `attachment-drift` rather than being ingested -- correct behaviour, and surprising after a close. The close then prints `intent st hydrate <ID>` as the way to write the files back, and `Facade::hydration` PINS UNCONDITIONALLY at `facade.rs:5555` ("STEP ONE: PIN. First, and unconditionally, because it is the step the obvious ordering skips"); `intentfiles::pin` has exactly two callers in the tree, that one and `edit_list`'s explicit `ListAction::Add`. So the offered remedy silently reverses half the close. Use the attachment route in vc decision 33 instead, and never reach for `hydrate` on a closed thread to fix one file.
